The '''Ministry of Intelligence''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ministry that supervised the [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] services active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One of the Ministry's workers was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]]. A friend of [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], Golec provided her with a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] testimony that had been delivered to the Ministry during the Duchess's fight to keep the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] out of the Clone Wars. The testimony was from New Mandalorian [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]] [[Jerec/Legends|Jerec]], who claimed that his government was capable of rooting out the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] terrorists that plagued the world without the need for Republic intervention. The testimony had been doctored by someone within the Republic government and made to sound as if Jerec was, in fact, begging for Republic aid. After being provided with the true recording, Kryze delivered it to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and prevented a [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|military occupation]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].
